case.title: The Vanishing Heir
case.introduction: A rich man is set to give his fortune. He disappears. The guests must find who hid his true name.
case.crime: The heir vanished after dinner. He may have been taken.
case.escape_plan: Use the service elevator to the garage. Hide in the car. Drive away.

rooms.name: Library
rooms.description: Shelves of books and a desk.

rooms.name: Kitchen
rooms.description: Stove, fridge and a prep area.

characters.background: Works for the family. Plans events.
characters.secret: She stole a necklace years ago.
lies: I saw the target near the safe.

characters.name: Marco Ruiz
characters.secret: He owes money to a loan shark.
lies: I heard a scream from the hallway.

characters.name: Jordan Vale
characters.secret: They are the missing heir using the name Eliot Marlow.
lies: I was with the chef at dinner.

characters.name: Victor Shaw
characters.secret: He once helped a thief escape.

relationships.detail: Victor and Marco trust each other.

lies: I saw the assistant near the safe.

timeline.description: Dinner starts in the dining hall.
A loud crash is heard in the library.

evidence.name: Library keycard
evidence.description: Keycard found on a desk in the library.

evidence.name: Garden camera clip
evidence.description: Clip shows a figure in the garden at 8:05 PM.

hidden_clues: The assistant used a keycard at 8:10 PM.
The fake passport matches the missing heir's birthdate.
red_herrings: Chef was seen near the safe.
Security chief said he saw the planner near the safe.

solution.reasoning: Keycard and passport point to Jordan. The fake name matches the heir. Lies from others point elsewhere but are false.

state.current_objective: Find out which guest is not who they say they are.
